Immediate

  • Active: Israeli/US airstrikes on Iran. Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile strikes on Israel. Northern border clashes daily.
  • Airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.

Northern Border

  • IDF shelled Hezbollah positions after a soldier was wounded in a clash in south Lebanon.
  • IDF reports strikes on 10 Hezbollah facilities; daily targeted strikes continue.
  • Lebanese health ministry: more than 4,300 killed in Israeli strikes since Mar 2.

Iran & Hormuz

  • US President announced a second 10-day pause on energy strikes until Apr 6 20:00 ET, citing an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks.

  • Iran allows Hormuz passage for Russia, India and China while blocking others — mitigates access for friendly states only.

Diplomacy & International

  • Pakistan mediating talks between parties.
  • Russian officials including Medvedev in Tehran for Khamenei ceremonies — increased Moscow visibility in Iran.
  • Japan in talks to buy Iranian oil under a temporary US sanctions waiver.

Other

  • USGS recorded a M4.3 earthquake 46 km SW of Hajjiabad, Iran.
  • 🟢 Good News: a 10-day pause on energy strikes announced; Pakistan mediation ongoing; Japanese buyers seeking sanctioned oil waivers.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • משרד הבריאות בלבנון: למעלה מ-4,300 הרוגים בתקיפות ישראל מאז 2 במרץ.

דיפלומטיה ובינלאומי

  • נציגים רוסים כולל מדבדב בטהרן לטקסי הלוויה של ח'אמנאי — נוכחות מוסקבה בולטת.

  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הוכרזה הפסקת תקיפות ל-10 ימים; פקיסטן מתווכת; פניות יפניות לרכישת נפט עם פטור זמני.
